newsitem.title: USA: Strong winds expected in North Sea Thurs/Fri - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Strong winds expected in North Sea Thurs/Fri - WSC.

text.p: Strong winds and very rough seas are expected in the North Sea on Thursday and Friday, private forecaster Weather Services Corp (WSC) said.
West southwest winds of 20-35 mph (32-56 kph) are forecast for Thursday and Friday with higher wind gusts to near 50 mph (80 kph) likely.

A powerful storm will track eastward from south of Iceland to the west of Scandinavia and north of Scotland. Gale-force winds will accompany this storm into the British Isles and the North Sea, WSC added.
